publication.citation: Kaminsky, F.V., Kostitsyn, Yu.A. (2025). Different Types of CaSiO3 in the Earth's Mantle and Its Geochemical Heterogeneity: the Juina Area in Brazil as an Example. Geochemistry International 63 (4), 295-306.
publication.notes: Table 1 (p. 299): major elements of 8 CaSiO3, Ca(Si,Ti)O3 and ferropericlase inclusions in three diamonds. Not extracted: the host diamonds' δ13C (printed per diamond as mean ± spread, n), Table 2 (trace elements), Table 3 (Rb-Sr, Sm-Nd, U-Pb isotopes) and the authors' depth interpretations. Table 1 labels 2.2.3a and 1.2.2a as ferropericlase, while Table 2 lists 2.2.3a among CaSiO3 grains; kept as printed.

tool: extraction/extract.py (pdftotext -layout; hints in this file under "extract"; table checked against a page image of p. 299) + scripts/build_gold.py

method.conditions: Quantitative electron probe microanalysis at 15 kV accelerating voltage, 20 nA sample current and 2 µm beam diameter; reference materials were simple compounds and pure metals.
